hardware: One exclusive NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 on a shared host; 8 allocated CPU cores
source_setup: Overlay exact production source, build its Rust radix extension with repository Torch configuration, install FlashInfer 0.7.3 without dependencies. Keep native version checks enabled; incompatible image cubin/JIT packages are ignored and matching code is downloaded/compiled.
model_command: python3 model_study.py --model /study/model --cache /study/results/model-<arm>-cache --arm <arm> --phase <phase> --observe-logit-differences --output /study/results/refresh-<ordinal>-<arm>-<phase>.json; add --no-perf for cold runs only
setup_incident: Initial remote-home artifact upload failed due storage/quota. Only our partial upload was removed; staging moved to node scratch before tests. No experiment results discarded.
limits: Bounded warm ABBA latency comparison, no full serving-throughput claim. Investigate any consistent regression above 3%; smaller measurements remain descriptive, not proof of equivalence. Both arms must pass the existing floor; a lower scoped paired score still merits inspection. No weakened parity tolerances or selection of favorable restarts.

matched_diagnostic.cache_preparation: python3 match_refresh_cache.py; disposable copies of original 20 baseline winners only; original hashes checked before and after
matched_diagnostic.model_command: Same model_study.py warm command with --cache /study/results/matched-<arm>-cache and matched-<ordinal>-<arm>-warm output names; no --observe-logit-differences override
matched_diagnostic.reason: Diagnose cross-arm numerical differences and approximately 1% slower observed natural-cache timing; keep original results separate.

archive_incident: Initial host-side archive hashing could not read container-owned cache files. Final archive is made inside the same container context; test results are unchanged.
